characters.name: Jonathan
characters.look: young Englishman in his mid-twenties, slim build, clean-shaven, short neat brown hair, earnest brown eyes, dark brown three-piece Victorian travelling suit, white high-collared shirt, dark green tie, small silver crucifix on a chain

characters.name: Count Dracula
characters.look: very tall gaunt old nobleman, pale waxy skin, sharp hooked nose, thick white moustache, bushy white eyebrows, pointed ears, sharp white teeth, red-tinged eyes, long black cloak with a high collar over black clothes

characters.name: Mina
characters.look: young Englishwoman in her early twenties, dark auburn hair in a neat Victorian bun, intelligent green eyes, calm determined expression, high-necked deep blue Victorian dress with a white lace collar, small silver brooch

characters.name: Lucy
characters.look: young Englishwoman of nineteen, long wavy golden-blonde hair with a pale pink ribbon, porcelain skin, light blue eyes, delicate features, flowing white Victorian dress with lace sleeves

characters.name: Van Helsing
characters.look: elderly Dutch professor in his sixties, stocky build, broad forehead, bushy grey eyebrows, short grey beard, deep-set blue eyes behind round spectacles, black frock coat, grey waistcoat, black leather doctor's bag

characters.name: Dr. Seward
characters.look: serious Englishman around thirty, tall and thin, short dark hair, neatly trimmed dark moustache, tired grey eyes, charcoal-grey Victorian suit, white doctor's coat over it

characters.name: Arthur Holmwood
characters.look: aristocratic young Englishman, tall and broad-shouldered, wavy light-brown hair, clean-shaven square jaw, hazel eyes, elegant black tailcoat, burgundy cravat, silver tie pin

characters.name: Quincey Morris
characters.look: rugged young Texan, tall and lean, sun-tanned face, sandy-blond hair, short beard, wide-brimmed brown cowboy hat, long tan leather duster coat, large bowie knife on his belt

characters.name: Renfield
characters.look: wild-eyed thin man in his fifties, gaunt unshaven face, messy thinning grey hair, frantic darting eyes, stained loose grey asylum shirt and trousers

characters.name: The Three Sisters
characters.look: three pale ghostly women, two with dark hair and one with golden hair, blood-red lips, sharp gleaming teeth, faintly glowing eyes, long sheer flowing white gowns

episodes.title: The Guest Who Couldn't Leave
episodes.summary: Jonathan Harker travels to Castle Dracula, discovers the Count has no reflection and is a prisoner, survives the three vampire women, and finds the Count asleep in a box of earth just as fifty boxes leave for London.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Count is on his way to London, and Jonathan is left behind with the three women.

episodes.title: The Lady in White
episodes.summary: The Demeter runs aground in Whitby with a dead captain and fifty boxes of earth. The Count feeds on Lucy; Van Helsing's garlic fails, a wolf breaks in, and Lucy dies, then rises as the lady in white who lures children.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lucy's tomb is empty, and the hunters must face what she has become.

episodes.title: The Final Hunt
episodes.summary: Arthur frees undead Lucy with a stake. The hunters destroy the Count's boxes, the Count attacks Mina, and through her hypnotic link they chase him home, defeat the three women and destroy him at sunset.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Count turns to dust and Mina is free.
